branding.greeting: Hey! Welcome to Crown & Co. I can quote services, check availability, or start a booking for you. What are you looking for?

stylists.name: Jasmine
stylists.specialty: Silk press, natural hair and treatments

policies.walkins: We're appointment-only. Same-day openings happen, so it's worth asking.
policies.cancellation: Cancel or reschedule at least 24 hours ahead. Inside 24 hours is a 50% fee.
policies.late: After 20 minutes late we may have to reschedule or shorten the service.
policies.deposit: Color, braids and sew-ins require a $50 deposit that goes toward your total.
policies.payment: Cash, card, Apple Pay, Cash App and Zelle. Cash tips appreciated.
policies.kids: Kids' cuts are $35 for 10 and under.
policies.consultation: Free 15-minute consultation for color and extensions before you commit.

faqs.q: Do I need a consultation for color?
faqs.a: For a big change — going blonde, a full correction, or extensions — yes, and it's free. For a root touch-up you can book straight in.
Plan on about 3 hours, longer if your hair is very long or dark. We'll give you a firm quote at the consultation.
Yes — silk presses, treatments, braids, sew-ins and protective styles. Jasmine and Ray specialize in it.

faqs.q: Should I come with my hair washed?
faqs.a: Come with hair dry and detangled, no heavy product. We'll wash it here as part of your service.
We're appointment-only, but same-day openings pop up. Tell me what you want and I'll get you on the list.

booking.confirm: Got it — you're on the request list. A stylist will text you to confirm your time and any deposit.
booking.handoff_note: For bridal or a big color change, calling the salon directly is fastest.
